verdict.rationale: The evidence shows per-credential IP allowlisting, ECDSA request signing, and workspace/organization structure. None of these documents permission scopes, role-limited keys, or least-privilege credential issuance for an agent. An IP allowlist restricts where a credential can be used from, not what it can do, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
